dct_description_sm: Intangible cost of transportation modes (walking, cycling, transit, and driving) within the City of Vancouver. Dataset contains City of Vancouver Cycling Quality Data (cycling.zip), City of Vancouver Road Quality Data (road.zip), City of Vancouver Transit Quality Data (transit.zip), and City of Vancouver Walking Quality Data (walk.zip). Information about Input Data Sources as well as software used for mapping and analysis is included in the README.txt file. Content type is GIS data. This dataset was originally deposited in the Simon Fraser University institutional repository.
dct_publisher_sm: Federated Research Data Repository / dépôt fédéré de données de recherche
dct_subject_sm: Aménagement du territoire et planification écologique
dct_title_s: City of Vancouver Intangible Transit Costs
